title: Generation of pure GABAergic neurons by transcription factor programming
protocol: Plate 5.0 × 10^6 HEK293T cells in 6 ml of MEF media on polyornithine-coated 10-cm plates, 16-24 hours prior to transfection.
Replace the media with fresh MEF media (9 ml).
Prepare 10 µg of lentiviral plasmid, 5 µg of pMDLg/pRRE, 2.5 µg of pRSV-rev, and 2.5 µg of pMD2.G in sterile water for each plate.
Add predetermined amount (40–120 μl) of 2.5M CaCl2 to the DNA mixture dropwise; final volume should be 500 μl.
Mix solution by vortexing for 10 seconds.
Add 500 µL of 2× BBS to the transfection mixture dropwise while vortexing, then incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Lightly mix the solution by pipetting up and down and add 1 ml of the transfection mixture dropwise to each plate of HEK293T cells.
Replace media with fresh MEF media (5 ml) 16-20 hours after transfection.
Check EGFP fluorescence of Tet-O-EGFP plate to ensure that the transfection worked properly.
Include at least one plate transfected with TetO-EGFP for every batch of lentiviral production.
Harvest viral supernatant 24 hours later (40-44 hours after transfection).
Filter the harvested viral supernatant through a 0.45 μm cellulose acetate filter.
Centrifuge the filtered solution at 50,000 × g for 1.5 h at 4 °C to concentrate the viral particles.
Reconstitute the pellet in 50 μl DMEM to obtain a 100× concentrated virus stock.
Store the reconstituted virus stock at 4 °C.
Titrate each reprogramming factor using 6 wells of a 12-well dish.
Perform a dilution series across the 6 wells using a range of 0.5–5 μl/virus in 1 ml media/well for hES/iPS cells.
Add doxycycline to induce expression and measure infection efficiency 48 h later using immunofluorescence with appropriate antibodies for each factor.
Fix and stain cells 48 h after the addition of doxycycline using standard procedures.
Determine infection efficiency by estimating the fraction of infected cells and use DAPI staining to mark all nuclei.
Optimal reprogramming efficiencies will be achieved when approximately 80-90 % of cells express Ascl1, Dlx2.
Anesthetize postnatal day 3 pups on ice.
Remove heads from pups and place them in a 10 cm tissue culture dish.
Dissect cortices from the brain and separate the two hemispheres.
Remove meninges using fine tweezers and place the hemisphere into a 15ml falcon tube filled with cold HBSS.
Collect all hemispheres from 3 pups, remove HBSS, and add 5 ml dissociation solution.
Filter the dissociation solution with a 0.22 µM filter and place at 37°C until clear.
Incubate the tube in a 37°C incubator for 15 min, shaking every 5 min.
Remove the dissociation solution carefully and wash tissue twice with MEF media.
Add 1 mL MEF media and use a pipette to triturate the tissue.
Transfer through a 0.40 µM cell strainer into the 50 mL falcon tube containing 5 mL MEF media.
Plate onto a 10cm plate.
Change the media on the next day.
Passage the cells in Glia media in 10cm dishes before using them for experiments to avoid neuron contamination.
Add Ara-C (4µM) in the media when cells are confluent, and use cells until they are 3-4 weeks old.
Plate human ES/iPS cells in Matrigel coated 6-well plate one day before infection with Accutase.
Dissociate human ES cells with Accutase and plate 5×10^4 to 1×10^5 cells/well using mTeSR with Thiazovivin.
Remove the mTeSR from the culture on the day of transduction and add 1ml mTeSR containing lentiviruses.
After 16-18 hours, remove virus-containing media and add N2 media with Doxycycline.
Change the media to N2 media with Doxycycline and proper antibiotics (puromycin and hygromycin) on day 4 if needed.
Add Ara-C (4µM) in N2 media with Doxycycline on day 5.
Plate iN cells together with mouse glial cells matrigel coated coverslip on days 7-8.
Dissociate primary mouse glial culture (passage 1) from a 10cm-dish with Trypsin/EDTA and split onto 36-48 coverslips.
Dissociate iN cells with Accutase, adjust the number to 4×10^5, and mix with mouse glial cells in 0.6 ml Growth Medium with Doxycycline on one coverslip.
Change half of the media on Day 9 or 10 using Growth Medium with Doxycycline.
Add Ara-C (4 µM) into the Growth Medium when glial cells reach ~80-90% confluence.
Remove Doxycycline from the Growth Medium on Day 15 and add BDNF.
Change half of the media (0.3 ml) every 3-4 days from Day 18 to 42 using Growth Medium with Ara-C (4 µM) and BDNF.
